sources.description: Primary source. All European cities with an estimated population of at least 5000 in the snapshot year (the threshold matches Bairoch 1988). Snapshot years absent from the 700–2000 grid are filled by log-linear interpolation and flagged natureOfEstimate: "imputed"; the upstream natureofestimate column ("" / imputed / proxied) is propagated for grid years.

sources.source: Historical Urban Population (Reba, Reitsma & Seto 2016; Chandler 系列)
sources.description: Supplement for cities absent from Buringh 2021 (matched by official name → synonym list → coordinates within 15 km; mostly cities outside Europe proper). Population records within -50/+25 years of the snapshot are used directly; gaps with records on both sides are filled by log-linear interpolation and flagged natureOfEstimate: "imputed" — no one-sided extrapolation.
